blockers: no reuse licence for a paid product (NJDOT pages cite 23 USC 407)
newest posted year is 2023; 2024+ only in the interactive portal
GPS on 26-38% of 2017-2022 crashes: placement leans on street names, 82-89% within 250 ft on TIGER (below the 98% auto gate)
county routes 600+ written only by number don't place (TIGER lacks those numbers)
NJ HSIP crash costs are HSM 2001 dollars with no index named: not printed
